verses.text: Ha winhaj Josías chi', wajxake' ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix schaanel yich winh yak'an reyal. 31 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winh te wach' t'a yichanh Jehová, tz'akan ix sb'eyb'alej winh icha sb'eyb'alejnak winhaj David smam yicham winh.

Ayik 16 ab'ilxo sk'inal winhaj Josías chi', ayik kelem unin wal winh, ix yak'an wal och winh t'a sk'ool sk'anab'ajan Jehová sDiosal winhaj David smam yicham winh. Haxo yik 20 ab'il winh, ix syamanoch winh yik'anel tas manh wach'ok t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ix schekan winh satjiel masanil juntzanh b'aj tz'och ejmelal b'ajtak chaanh, yechel komon Dios Asera yet' juntzanhxo yechel komon Dios tzeyb'il yet' masanil yechel b'ob'il t'a k'een k'een.

Ha wal t'a yichanh winh ix mak'jipoj juntzanh altar yik masanil yechel Baal. Ix schekanpax winh mak'jipoj altar b'aj snhuschajtz'a incienso b'ajtak chaanh. Ix schekanpax winh mak'jipoj yechel komon Dios Asera yet' masanil juntzanhxo yechel komon Dios. Chok' ix ajkan smasanil. Ixlajwi chi' ix stzikanb'at winh t'a yib'anh b'ajtak mukan heb' ix ak'an silab' t'a juntzanh yechel chi'.
Ix schekanpax winh nhusjoktz'a sb'akil heb' sacerdote t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi' t'a yib'anh juntzanh altar chi'. Ichaton chi' ix aj sakb'itan Judá yet' Jerusalén chi' winh.
Icha pax chi' ix sk'ulej winh t'a juntzanh chonhab' mak'b'ilem lanhnaj t'a yol yik Manasés, t'a yol yik Efraín yet' t'a yol yik Simeón, masanto ix k'och t'a yol yik Neftalí.

Ayik ix lajwi smak'jikanpoj masanil juntzanh altar, juntzanh yechel komon Dios Asera yet' juntzanhxo yechel komon Dios, chok' ix ajkani, ix mak'jipaxkanpoj masanil altar b'aj stz'a incienso t'a masanil yol yik Israel chi'. Ichato chi' ix meltzajxi winh t'a Jerusalén.

Ayik 26 ab'ilxo sk'inal winhaj Josías chi', ayik toxo ix sakb'itej masanil jun nación chi' winh yet' skajnub' Jehová Dios, ix schekan winh wach' b'ochaj skajnub' Dios chi'. Ix ochkan jun munlajel chi' t'a yib'anh winhaj Safán yuninal winhaj Azalías yet' winhaj Amasías yajal t'a chonhab' Jerusalén yet' winh tz'ib'um, haton winhaj Joa yuninal winhaj Joacaz.

Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at heb' winh tik yil winhaj Hilcías sat sacerdote. Ix b'at yak'an k'een tumin heb' winh t'a winh, haton k'een ix scha heb' winh levita stanhwan spuertail stemplo Dios t'a heb' yinhtilal Manasés yet' heb' yinhtilal Efraín, haton masanil heb' kannak t'a yol yik Israel. Ay pax k'een ix yak' heb' yinhtilal Judá, heb' yinhtilal Benjamín yet' heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'ankan k'een tumin chi' heb' winh t'a heb' winh ayoch yilan munlajel t'a stemplo Jehová chi', haxo heb' winh stupan heb' winh smunlaj t'a templo chi'.

Ix yak'anpax k'een tumin chi' heb' winh t'a heb' winh nhikum te' yet' t'a heb' winh skuchb'an munlajel chi', yik smanchaj k'een k'een tzeyb'il yet' pax masanil te te' tz'och syamnub'alok yet' pax spatzab'il juntzanh pat emnakkan lanhnaj yuj heb' winh sreyal Judá.

Ha juntzanh heb' winh winak chi', te wach' ix yutej heb' winh yilan munlajel chi'. Ha heb' winh skuchb'an munlajel chi', a heb' winh levita, haton sb'i heb' winh tik: Winhaj Jahat yet' winhaj Abdías yinhtilal winhaj Merari, winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Mesulam yinhtilal winhaj Coat. Ha heb' winh tik yajal yaj heb' winh. Ay juntzanhxo heb' winh levita kuchb'um t'a b'it yet' pax t'a yamk'ab' yik b'it chi', a heb' winh tz'ilan heb' kuchum ikatz, ay pax heb' winh tz'ilan heb' smunlaji. Ay pax heb' winh tz'ib'um, ay pax heb' winh stanhwan spuertail skajnub' Dios chi'.
Ayik wan yik'chajelta k'een tumin ix b'at ak'chajkan t'a skajnub' Jehová chi', haxo winhaj sacerdote Hilcías ix ilanelta yumal b'aj aykan sley Jehová yuj winhaj Moisés.
Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Safán winh tz'ib'um to ix ilchaj yumal ley t'a skajnub' Jehová. Ix yak'ankan winh t'a winhaj Safán chi'.
Haxo winhaj Safán chi' ix ik'anb'at t'a winh rey chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, a onh a chekab' onh tik wan ko b'oan masanil munlajel aykan och t'a kib'anh.
Ix molb'aj k'een tumin ix ul ak'chajkan t'a skajnub' Jehová, ix ak'chaj k'een t'a heb' winh tz'ilan munlajel chi' yet' pax t'a heb' winh smunlaji, xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winh t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: Ha winhaj Hilcías ix yak' jun uum winh t'ayin, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yawtan jun uum chi' winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.
Ha wal yik ix yab'an winh rey tas syal jun uum chi', ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul winh.

Ix yawtankot winhaj Hilcías winh, winhaj Ahicam yuninal winhaj Safán, winhaj Abdón yuninal winhaj Micaía, winhaj Safán winh tz'ib'um yet' winhaj Asaías ay yopisio skolwaj yet' winh. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik:

--Ixikek, b'at k'anb'ejek t'a Jehová wuuj, yuj pax masanil anima kannak t'a Israel tik yet' t'a Judá yuj tas syal jun uum ix ilchaj tik. Tekan aykot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a kib'anh tiknaik, yujto a heb' ko mam kicham maj sk'anab'ajej heb' tas syal Jehová, maj sb'eyb'alej pax heb' tastak aykan t'a jun uum tik, xchi winh rey chi'.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Hilcías yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh ix chekjib'at yuj winh rey chi', ix b'at heb' winh yil ix Hulda ix schekab' Dios, ix yetb'eyum winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Ticva, yixchikin winhaj Harhas. Ha winhaj Salum chi' sik'an masanil pichul t'a skajnub' Dios. kajan ix Hulda chi' t'a jun scha makanhil chonhab' t'a Jerusalén. Ayik ix yalan heb' winh t'a ix,
ix tak'wi ix t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ha Jehová ko Diosal tz'alan icha tik: Alek t'a winh ix ex chekankot he k'anb'ej chi' t'ayin
to a in Jehová in tik swala': Ol wak'kot junok yaelal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a yib'anh masanil anima kajan t'ay, icha wal yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a jun uum ix awtaj t'a ichanh chi'.

Yujto ix in eyaktejkani, haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios tze nhus incienso. Tze tzuntzankot yowal in k'ol yuj masanil tas ix he k'ulej chi'. Yuj chi' toxo ix kot yowal in k'ool t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik, maxtzak tuplaj.
Yuj chi' alek t'a winh sreyal Judá, winh ix ex chekankot ul he k'anb'ej t'ayin Jehová sDiosal in Israel tik to a in swal icha tik: Yujto ix a cha ab' tas syal jun uum chi',

ix ak'an wal och t'a a k'ool, ix ak'anoch a b'a t'a yol in k'ab' ayik ix ab'ani to ay yowal in k'ol t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a yib'anh heb' kajan t'ay, yujto ix ik'em a b'a t'a wichanh, ix a nhik'chitanb'at a pichul, ix ach ok'i, hanhejtona' in ix wab' pax tas ix ala'. Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová in swal t'ayach:

Ha in ol wak'elk'ochi to junk'olal ol ach chamok, ol ach mukchaj b'aj mukan heb' a mam icham. Ichato chi' ol jawok juntzanh yaelal ol wak'kot t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a yib'anh masanil heb' kajan t'ay, xchi Jehová, xchi ix Hulda chi'. Yuj chi' ix meltzaj heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi', ix ul yalan spak tas ix b'at sk'anb'ej heb' winh chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix schekan winh rey chi' awtajkot masanil heb' winh yichamtak winakil Judá yet' heb' yik Jerusalén chi' to smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e winh rey chi' t'a skajnub' Jehová yet' masanil heb' ix smolb'ej sb'a chi' yet' pax heb' winh sacerdote, heb' winh levita yet' masanil anima ay t'a yol smakb'en chi' yet' pax masanil heb' unin yet' masanil heb' ichamtak anima. Hata' ix schek winh rey chi' awtaj jun uum chi' yab' masanil anima chi', haton tastak aykan t'a yumal strato Jehová ix ilchajelta yuj heb' t'a yol templo chi'.

Ix och linhan winh rey chi' t'a stz'ey jun niwan oy. Hata' ix yak' sti' winh t'a yichanh Jehová to t'a wal smasanil sk'ool winh ol sk'anab'ajej sb'eyb'alan masanil cheknab'il yet' k'ayb'ub'al chi', icha wal yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a yumal strato Jehová chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a masanil anima molanek' chi', heb' aj Jerusalén yet' heb' yik Benjamín to syak' sti' heb' sk'anab'ajani. Masanil heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi', ix sk'anab'ajej heb' icha wal yajkan t'a yumal strato sDiosal heb' yet' heb' smam yicham.

Ix schekan winhaj Josías chi' ik'jokel masanil yechel yajb'entak ay t'a yol smakb'en Israel chi'. Ix yalan winh to tz'och masanil heb' ayek' t'a Israel chi' ejmelal t'a Jehová Dios. Yakb'an pitzanto winh, maj yik'el sb'a heb' t'a Jehová sDiosal heb' smam yicham heb'.
